product_one_liner.value: HAAS Alert’s Safety Cloud helps emergency and roadway fleets prevent collisions by sending real-time hazard alerts to approaching drivers through connected vehicles and navigation apps.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page describes collision prevention through real-time alerts about emergency vehicles, crews, work zones and hazards. The About page identifies emergency and roadway fleets, connected vehicles and navigation apps: https://haasalert.com/safety-cloud and https://www.haasalert.com/about.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page links industry-specific plans and lists the separately sold HA-7 device at $399: https://www.haasalert.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: HAAS Alert publishes customer case studies for WJ Group and DC Fire and EMS Department. The latter explicitly says the department added Safety Cloud protection to its fleet: https://www.haasalert.com/case-study/wj-group-safety-cloud and https://www.haasalert.com/case-study/case-study-dc-fire-ems-department. | named_customers.0: The company’s case study identifies WJ Group using Safety Cloud for road-worker safety. | named_customers.1: The case study explicitly states that DC Fire and EMS Department added Safety Cloud protection to its fleet.

employee_band.notes: Built In reports 70 total employees, which falls within 51–100: https://www.builtinchicago.org/company/haas-alert. This is a third-party headcount.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The exhibitor profile explicitly labels the Chicago address as HAAS Alert’s global headquarters: https://www.emergencyuk.com/exhibitors/haas-alert. | hq_country: The exhibitor profile explicitly labels the Chicago, United States address as HAAS Alert’s global headquarters: https://www.emergencyuk.com/exhibitors/haas-alert.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2015. This primary-source statement takes precedence over a conflicting directory entry: http://haasalert.com/news/safety-cloud-for-auto.

eng_blog.notes: The readable media index contains product updates and roadway-safety marketing content, including a Spring 2026 product update and a distracted-driving article. It does not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built: https://haasalert.com/media.

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base exposes multiple product articles, including digital-alert explanations, transponder installation and external-antenna guidance: https://haas.knowledgeowl.com/help/digital-alerting. It is more than a single FAQ page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer, Product Manager and Technical Delivery & Solutions Lead. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title: https://www.haasalert.com/careers.

model_provider.notes: Unknown. Product documentation, the media index, Trust Center and privacy policy did not identify an AI model or model-inference provider. The Neutron Edge announcement describes an AI-routing platform partnership, not a disclosed model vendor. Sources checked include https://support.haasalert.com/help, https://haasalert.com/media, https://www.haasalert.com/trust-center, https://www.haasalert.com/privacy and https://www.haasalert.com/news/haas-alert-neutron-edge-ai-powered-emergency-response.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center publicly claims SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR compliance, without describing these as in progress: https://www.haasalert.com/trust-center. GDPR is included as requested, although it is a compliance claim rather than a conventional certification. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly names SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center explicitly names ISO/IEC 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center explicitly claims GDPR compliance.

value.stage: Growth investment (classified as Seed by Tracxn)

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The investor calls the latest transaction a growth investment, whereas Tracxn classifies it as Seed. Both labels are retained rather than silently resolving that classification difference: https://www.volitioncapital.com/news/haas-alert-announcement and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/haas-alert/__LefkJ0oPZ_A4vq8A8kKpHf-SNw0zgpjgdSCQCsDavNE/funding-and-investors. | funding_date: The funding profile, updated November 4, 2026, identifies January 8, 2024 as the latest round, yielding 2024-01: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/haas-alert/__LefkJ0oPZ_A4vq8A8kKpHf-SNw0zgpjgdSCQCsDavNE/funding-and-investors. The investor announcement corroborates the event: https://www.volitioncapital.com/news/haas-alert-announcement. | funding_amount_usd: Unknown. The latest funding record leaves the round amount unavailable, and the investor announcement does not disclose it: https://www.volitioncapital.com/news/haas-alert-announcement. The public funding table contains inconsistent figures, so none was treated as a reliable USD amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile updated in November 2026 still identifies January 8, 2024 as the latest round, before the May 2025 start of the 18-month window: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/haas-alert/__LefkJ0oPZ_A4vq8A8kKpHf-SNw0zgpjgdSCQCsDavNE/funding-and-investors. The dated investment announcement is https://www.volitioncapital.com/news/haas-alert-announcement.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the three openings on the careers page is an SDR, BDR or account-executive role; RevOps does not qualify under the requested definition: https://www.haasalert.com/careers.

launched_6mo.notes: HAAS Alert announced Safety Cloud for Android Automotive on June 2, 2026, within the six-month window. It is a substantive embedded automotive application, not a minor UI change: https://www.haasalert.com/news/haas-alert-safety-cloud-for-android-automotive.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small eight-person leadership roster and available dated profiles were checked, with no company-level C-suite/VP hire or departure identified during the window. Hussein Zaarour was already a HAAS Alert VP in May 2025. Brock Aun’s July 2026 move to Chief Strategy Officer was an internal promotion, not joining or leaving the company. Sources: https://theorg.com/org/haas-alert/teams/leadership-team, https://linkedin.com/in/brockaun and https://www.haasalert.com/news/mitsubishi-electrics-flexconnect-joins-safety-cloud. The negative conclusion remains subject to incomplete public announcements.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer posting explicitly names HubSpot, RevOps.io, Gong and RevHero as the existing stack the employee will administer: https://www.haasalert.com/roles/revops-manager-gtm-engineer. | crm_stack_signal.0: HubSpot is explicitly named in the existing RevOps stack. | crm_stack_signal.1: RevOps.io is explicitly named in the existing RevOps stack. | crm_stack_signal.2: Gong is explicitly named in the existing RevOps stack. | crm_stack_signal.3: RevHero is explicitly named in the existing RevOps stack.
